title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Trump moves on the Fed, Italy warns ‘fin-fluencers’: Global Express
summary: US President Donald Trump is bringing criminal charges against the head of the Fed in what many see as a political move motivated by a desire for lower interest rates.

title: Trump says ‘Venezuela leaker’ jailed as Polymarket accounts go quiet
summary: US President Donald Trump said the “leaker on Venezuela has been found and is in jail” as some Polymarket accounts tied to early bets on Maduro’s ouster go silent.

title: Jefferies’ ‘Greed & Fear’ strategist cuts Bitcoin allocation to zero on quantum risk
summary: Jefferies’ Greed & Fear strategist Christopher Wood has slashed a 10% Bitcoin allocation from his portfolio and moved into gold, citing the quantum risk to BTC, Bloomberg reports.

title: Belarus creates legal framework for ‘cryptobanks’ in new presidential decree
summary: The rules allow banks to combine token activity with payments and financial services under central bank and tech park oversight.

title: Crypto exchanges face ban in South Korea as Google Play updates rules
summary: Google will require proof of FIU registration acceptance for crypto apps, raising compliance hurdles for offshore exchanges serving South Korean users.

title: Bitcoin traders predict ‘strong run-up’ as classic chart targets $113K
summary: The recovery may continue as long as Bitcoin achieves a daily close above $98,000, with the technical setup projecting 18% gains ahead.

title: Moldova moves to regulate crypto under EU-style MiCA rules
summary: Moldova plans to introduce its first crypto law in 2026, aligning with the EU’s MiCA framework while warning citizens about digital asset risks.

title: Polygon trims workforce amid $250M stablecoin payments pivot
summary: The restructuring comes as the company integrates new payments assets and narrows its mandate, with several employees saying on X that they were affected by the layoffs.

title: KBC Bank to launch Bitcoin and Ether trading in Belgium under MiCA
summary: The lender will offer crypto trading through its Bolero platform as Belgium’s MiCA rules take effect, despite no licenses yet appearing on the ESMA’s register.
